ideas.text: Tiziran packages a computer-vision career into one public hub for consulting, courses, and open-source tools.
Deduction: the positioning is embedded and edge deployment — Jetson, Hailo, Axelera, Coral, FPGA — rather than model research.
Free reusable artifacts such as the OpenCV5 NuGet static libraries and the cvtest framework feed the consulting pipeline.
cvtest argues computer vision has no standard test suite and proposes PSNR, SSIM, and hardware benchmarks as acceptance criteria.
Structured learning paths — courses, workshops, book summaries, roadmaps — drive long-tail discovery of the site.

notes.title: Dual-Format PKM Prompt — AI Second Brain with PARA and Progressive Summarization
notes.summary: This note captures a complete dual-format PKM prompt that creates paired HTML and Markdown notes with PARA organization, Progressive Summarization, and a strict filesystem sandbox.
notes.compact_idea: Run PKM captures through a dual HTML-Markdown pipeline with PARA and Progressive Summarization.

ideas.text: The PKM prompt creates paired HTML and Markdown notes for every capture, keeping both trees in lockstep.
PARA organizes notes by actionability: projects, areas, resources, and archives — stored as metadata, not duplicate folders.
Progressive Summarization compresses notes through five layers: excerpts, bold, highlight, paraphrase, remix.
The filesystem sandbox constraint prevents the agent from writing outside the allowed vault root.
